tips.text: Run your weekly Archon Hunt and let the parts pile up; full squads spawn more Symbilysts.
Bring Nekros Desecrate, a Chesa Kubrow or Ivara's Prowl at 100% power strength; loot effects work on Symbilysts.
After the 20-kill objective on the Sentient Anomaly, re-queue the node from the nav console; aborting has cost players their drops.
Park your Railjack inside or right in front of the Anomaly where fighters cannot reach it, and use Loot Radar.
Expect to finish passively within some weeks of weekly Archon Hunts, faster in a full squad.
